== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ゼヴ・セネスカ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。ローグ２を操縦するなら回避値に３を加え、戦闘運命数を引けない場合にも１枚引ける。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ベスティーン星系に近いケスティック・ステーションの出身。あらゆる機種を乗りこなす温和なパイロット。ホスの氷原でルークとハンを発見した。ホスの戦いではローグ2を操縦。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Zev Senesca.

'''Lore''' — Born at Kestic Station near the Bestine system. A mild-mannered pilot who can handle every craft. He found Luke and Han on Hoth's ice plains. He piloted Rogue 2 at the Battle of Hoth.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 2, also add 3 to maneuver, and may draw one battle destiny even if not able to otherwise.

Lore calls him 温和な (mild-mannered); English says daring. 氷原 (ice plains) replaces wasteland. Game text and printed stats match: power 2, ability 2, deploy 2, forfeit 4, Pilot and Warrior.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-zevsenesca-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Zev Senesca]].</ref>
